state.seed_assertion: A DPIA should begin early in the life of a project, before processing starts, and run alongside the planning and development process.

sentences.1: A DPIA should begin early in the life of a project, before processing starts, and run alongside the planning and development process.
sentences.2: A DPIA should begin early in the life of a project, before you start your processing, and run alongside the planning and development process.
sentences.3: A DPIA should begin early in the life of a project, before you start your processing, and run alongside the planning and development process.
sentences.4: A DPIA should begin early in the life of a project, before you start your processing, and run alongside the planning and development process.
sentences.5: A DPIA should begin early in a project lifecycle, before processing starts, and run alongside the planning and development process.
sentences.6: Innovative technology refers to new developments in technological knowledge at large rather than technology that is new only to the controller.
sentences.7: Recital 91 says innovative technology concerns new developments in technological knowledge in the world at large, rather than technology that is new to you
sentences.8: If a high risk cannot be mitigated, the organization must consult the ICO before starting the processing.
sentences.9: The DPIA process is designed to be flexible and scalable to fit the nature of the project and existing risk management approaches.
sentences.10: You can design a process that fits with your existing approach to managing risks and projects, as long as it contains these key elements.
